title: How do I assess a Corporate Wellness Partnership late-payment fee?
content:
A late-payment fee is added to the employer's master account once a scheduled billing-cycle charge on a Corporate Wellness Partnership enrollment has remained unpaid for more than the tier's grace period after it was billed. Assessing this fee increases the net amount currently owed by the employer's master account and adds a dues-billed entry to the enrollment's billing history for the relevant cycle.

This is done using an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): bill_corp_late_fee_4428c2eb.

Parameters:
- enrollment_id — the reference number of the enrollment the late fee is assessed against, read from the enrollment record.
- amount_usd — the dollar amount of the late fee, in USD, rounded to exactly 2 decimal places.
- billing_cycle_month — the missed billing cycle this late fee relates to, in YYYY-MM form (four-digit year, hyphen, two-digit month).

Return: a confirmation of the new billing-history entry's reference number, the late-fee amount assessed, the billing cycle it relates to, and the enrollment's resulting balance owed by the employer's master account. No further error condition beyond an unrecognized enrollment reference is defined here.
